hatch.title: Hatch a pet
hatch.blurb: Creates and registers a pet suited to the current folder. Start here.
hatch.example: /pets-driven:hatch analyse the projects under ~/projects and hatch a fitting pet for each

bring.title: Bring a project in
bring.blurb: Clones a remote repo or adds a worktree from a local one, so your pet has something to work on.
bring.example: /pets-driven:bring github.com/acme/web into this folder and connect it to the pet

carry.title: Hand off to the next agent
carry.blurb: Summarises what was done and where it lives (worktree, branch) so the next agent can pick it up.
carry.example: /pets-driven:carry summarise this work so another agent can continue it

settings.title: Settings
settings.terminalDesc: The shell the in-app terminal opens, and the one a pet's launch line runs in.
settings.petSourcesDesc: The folder scanned for pet packs. With no folder set, only the built-in pets show.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the language for the Pets-Driven interface.
settings.appearanceDesc: Use a light or dark theme, or follow your system.
settings.petWindowModePerPetDesc: Every pet gets its own always-on-top window, so each one layers against your other windows on its own.
settings.petWindowModeSingleDesc: All your pets share one see-through window over the whole desktop. Lighter with a big roster, but they layer as one.
settings.quietModeOffDesc: Your pets live their ordinary life: they chatter, they wander, they play with each other.
settings.quietModeQuietDesc: Your pets stop talking — no idle lines, no chatting with each other, no answering back when you pet them. They still move, and they still report what your agent is doing.
settings.quietModeStillDesc: Quiet, and your pets also stay exactly where they are. You can still pick one up, and they still report what your agent is doing.
settings.accentColorDesc: The color used across the app for highlights and active states.
settings.agentConnectionDesc: Connect Claude Code and Codex so your pets react while agents work.
settings.defaultTerminalDesc: The shell the in-app terminal opens, detected from your system. Pick “System default” to follow COMSPEC / SHELL.
settings.resetAllDesc: Put every setting back to its default, or remove all your pets and start over from the welcome screen.
settings.resetAllConfirmHint: Terminal, pets folder, appearance and language go back to their defaults. Your pets, their folders and their looks are not touched.
settings.resetPetsConfirmHint: All your pets, their watch folders and their looks are deleted, and the app returns to the welcome screen. This cannot be undone.
settings.commandDesc: The line typed into the terminal when you double-click a pet, run in that pet's working folder.
settings.sectionTerminalDesc: The shell your pets open and the command they run.
settings.sectionAgentDesc: Let your coding agents tell your pets what they are up to.
settings.sectionPetsDesc: Where pets come from, and how they sit on your desktop.
settings.sectionAppearanceDesc: How the app looks and which language it speaks.
settings.sectionUpdatesDesc: Your installed version and signed app updates.
settings.appVersionDesc: Check for a newer signed release and install it without downloading the setup file yourself.
settings.updateReady: Updates are checked only when you ask.
settings.updateRestartWarning: Installing closes Pets Driven, including any terminals open inside it. Save unfinished terminal work first.
settings.updateFailed: The update could not be completed.
settings.sectionResetDesc: Start over — settings, pets, or both.

playful.title: Playful
playful.blurb: First to play, last to nap. Explores every corner of the screen.

attentive.title: Attentive
attentive.blurb: Sticks close and checks in often. Loves reporting back to you.

reserved.title: Reserved
reserved.blurb: Quiet and careful. Prefers a cozy spot and steady work.

curious.title: Curious
curious.blurb: Investigates every odd corner, then comes back with findings.

steady.title: Steady
steady.blurb: Calm, consistent, and hard to rattle. Keeps the rhythm smooth.

feisty.title: Feisty
feisty.blurb: Spirited and quick to bristle. Proud, scrappy, and always up for a challenge.

gentle.title: Gentle
gentle.blurb: Warm and unhurried. Drifts your way and stays close without fuss.

mischievous.title: Mischievous
mischievous.blurb: Unpredictable and impulsive. You never quite know what it'll do next.

lazy.title: Lazy
lazy.blurb: Barely moves. Perfectly content to just exist in one cozy spot.

zen.title: Zen
zen.blurb: Unhurried and unflappable. Moves with quiet purpose, never in a rush.

aloof.title: Aloof
aloof.blurb: Keeps to itself. Slow to warm up, and usually waves off company.

skittish.title: Skittish
skittish.blurb: Spooks at the slightest thing. Darts around, then bolts when a friend comes near.

shrewd.title: Shrewd
shrewd.blurb: Cool and calculating. Reads the room, plays its own angles, and is never caught off guard.
